summary: Require explicit confirmation for live CLI and MCP writes using the credential actually sent, while allowing request-free CLI previews.
reason: Stripe live mutations affect real accounts. The guard recognizes secret and restricted live keys, including encoded Basic and Bearer headers, without treating unused credentials or request-free previews as live requests.
validated_outcome: Synthetic tests block unconfirmed live writes before HTTP, preserve CLI dry-run previews, require top-level boolean MCP confirmation, and strip nested confirmation controls from Stripe request bodies for live and test credentials.
